import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int M = 21;
    static final double eps = 1e-6;
    static int n = 0, k, m;
    static double[] p = new double[M];
    static int[] id = new int[M];
    static double[] ans = new double[M];
    static double[] d = new double[1 << M];

    static void read(Scanner sc) {
        m = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            double x = sc.nextDouble();
            if (x > eps) {
                p[n] = x;
                id[n] = i;
                n++;
            } else {
                ans[i] = 0.0;
            }
        }
    }

    static void kill() {
        if (k >= n) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                ans[id[i]] = 1.0;
            }
        } else {
            Arrays.fill(d, 0.0);
            d[0] = 1.0;

            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(mask) < k) {
                    double sum = 0.0;
                    for (int t = 0; t < n; t++) {
                        if (((mask >> t) & 1) == 0) {
                            sum += p[t];
                        }
                    }
                    if (sum > 0) {
                        for (int t = 0; t < n; t++) {
                            if (((mask >> t) & 1) == 0) {
                                int nextMask = mask ^ (1 << t);
                                d[nextMask] += p[t] / sum * d[mask];
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == k) {
                    for (int t = 0; t < n; t++) {
                        if (((mask >> t) & 1) == 1) {
                            ans[id[t]] += d[mask];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            System.out.print(ans[i] + " ");
        }
        System.out.println();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        // Set precision similar to C++ fixed with 10 decimal places
        // but Java's default print is sufficient here
        read(sc);
        kill();
        sc.close();
    }
}
